controlled.integer_budget: Python round(nd*d), ties to even; save actual n
controlled.reuse: D-optimal native and SpanCancel LP results reused across replicates; common SC reuses native

rff.sample: rng0 choose 12000 from California; first6000 for M50/100, all12000 for M200

stress.enumeration: all supports of sizes1..n for rep0 N6/8; numerical row-span lower-bound pruning; NM8 random plus uniform starts800 iterations; other above-bound cases visit at most120 supports and stop on numerical coefficient/cancellation recovery
stress.frontier: d3,4,6; random,blocks,perturbed_blocks,overlap; all n=d..2d; six native methods and baseline common reweighting

adversarial.claim: heuristic search, no global counterexample certification

runtime.timing: runtime suite alone after other experiment processes finish; includes fullfit/residual/candidates/LP/fallback/finalvalidation; excludes data generation, file IO and diagnostic-only condition SVD

seeds: SHA256 of stable run labels; first four bytes interpreted little endian; split and feature seeds explicit
stopping: fixed grids, NMmaxiter400 baseline800 stronger, tolerances saved; no exclusion for unfavorable results
zero_thresholds: ratio near1 abs<=1e-7; certificate separately requires full positive-support rank plus cancellation and coefficient tolerance

statistical_plan.primary: ten controlled dataset means over method draws, native weights, budget_factor1.5; no seeds as independent datasets
statistical_plan.omnibus: Friedman paired ranks with ties; Holm over two protocol omnibus pvalues
statistical_plan.posthoc: Nemenyi all-pairs per protocol, if Holm omnibus significant; multiply posthoc adjusted pvalues by2 for two protocols
statistical_plan.targeted: two-sided paired Wilcoxon of dataset-mean log-ratio baseline minus SpanCancel; five baselines x two protocols =10 Holm family; zero if absolute log difference<=1e-10, average tied ranks, wilcox removal of zeros, exact sign-flip rank permutation over 2^nonzero<=1024
statistical_plan.effect: median and mean paired log difference, exponentiated median fold difference; win/tie/loss with same1e-10 threshold
statistical_plan.uncertainty: replicate SD ddof1, median, mean, geometric mean; deterministic duplicate SD labeled0 no stochastic inference; per-dataset mean95% t intervals descriptive conditional on fixed dataset; macro geometric mean of dataset arithmetic means, arithmetic mean and median reported; no pooling versions of California as distinct datasets
statistical_plan.limitations: ten curated datasets including scalar classification labels and small dependent-row econometric data; inference conditional to this suite, no population or generalization claim; all other cuts descriptive

release_scope: Saved settings for the reported experiments. The experiment runners implement these grids.
